records.run: H-alpha luminosity function, binned (Table 4, corrected phi)

axes.xDefinition: log10 H-alpha line luminosity, corrected for [NII] contamination and for dust extinction (A(Halpha) = 1 mag)
axes.yDefinition: log10 comoving number density of H-alpha emitters per dex of luminosity (the paper's phi corr: corrected for incompleteness and for the filter profile)

selection.population: narrow-band selected H-alpha emitters (rest-frame EW(Halpha+[NII]) > 25 A), COSMOS and UDS fields
selection.warning: Luminosities carry a constant A(Halpha) = 1 mag for every galaxy and a statistical [NII] correction (median [NII]/(Halpha+[NII]) about 0.25), not a measurement per galaxy; the paper notes the bright end deviates from a Schechter function where AGN dominate, and the points are not AGN-corrected. Errors are Poisson plus 20 per cent of the completeness correction.

definitions.dustCorrectionMethod: constant A(Halpha) = 1 mag applied to every galaxy
definitions.apertureDefinition: fixed 3 arcsec diameter aperture at z = 0.4 (about 16 kpc, the same physical area as 2 arcsec at higher redshift)
definitions.population: narrow-band selected H-alpha emitters, EW(Halpha+[NII]) > 25 A rest frame (star-forming galaxies and AGN)

provenance.definitionBasis: densityFrame is stated as '(co-moving)' for the NB_H volume (z = 1.47) in the volume section; the other epochs' volumes are computed in the same paragraph in the same way (read, not stated)

records.notes: Table 4 transcribed (18 bins, 797 sources of 1742 Halpha emitters in Table 3). Checks: the Table 5 Schechter fit (log L*=41.95, log phi*=-3.12, alpha=-1.75) reproduces the points to rms 0.90 times the printed error (rms 0.26 dex); at this epoch the printed Schechter parameters integrate to log rho_L(41.6) = 38.62, 0.37 dex below the 38.99 printed in Table 5, so that check is not used here (the paper does not say why; the points themselves agree with the printed fit); the points and the fit give the same luminosity density over the bins (log rho 39.25 and 39.11).
